data.one_liner: Drop-in camera UI widget for taking photos with zoom, flash, and camera switching.
data.what_it_does: Provides a ready-to-use camera widget wrapped around the official camera plugin. It manages the preview, zoom, flash mode, and switching camera sides, returning the captured image file via a callback. Developers can embed it directly into a widget tree or open it in a modal route.
use_when: You need a quick, turnkey camera screen to take photos without building custom camera preview and control UI.
You want simple file callbacks for captured photos on Android and iOS.
avoid_when: You need extensive customization of the camera UI and layout.
You need video recording or exposure control (not yet supported according to roadmap).
You need advanced barcode scanning or MLKit integration.
strengths: Simple declarative usage via a single CameraCamera widget.
Built-in support for flash control, zoom, and toggling front/back cameras.
Returns captured images directly via an onFile callback.
weaknesses: Lacks custom layout support and advanced camera controls like manual exposure.
Platform support in pubspec metadata is limited to Android and iOS despite beta web support notes.
data.setup_notes: Requires setting minSdkVersion 21 in Android build.gradle, and NSCameraUsageDescription and NSMicrophoneUsageDescription keys in iOS Info.plist.

alternatives.name: camera
alternatives.why_pick_it: Use camera directly for full lower-level control over the camera stream, UI, video recording, and custom layouts.
